purpose: Measure a previously completed hiring path as a backup to the 18-day-shift target without inventing current job inventory or adding a second user request.

evidence.historical_listing_caveat: Rates and availability varied by job and timing; the June listing is not evidence of a current offer.

facts: The official flow says a hired worker completes employment-contract and required-information steps in the app, then can search for jobs.
The official FAQ says the registered email address is the app ID.
The official FAQ lists monthly pay as month-end close and next-month 20th payment.
The official FAQ lists optional faster payment as requestable two business days after work with a JPY 220 fee.
official_current_readback.reason: Do not spend from a zero external budget merely to accelerate cash settlement.

arithmetic.conclusion: The verified historical upper example does not reduce the evidence-backed minimum below 18 total workdays. It can hedge the risk that the current employer accepts fewer than 18 shifts.

decision.reason_for_zero: No current app inventory or accepted event assignment has been read back.
decision.user_request_change: Add only a read-only current-rate check when the app is already installed and logged in; do not install, re-register, disclose identity data, or accept a job in that check.

success_condition: A current physically safe job with known gross, date, commute and payment timing is accepted without overlapping an existing assignment.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw if the app account is inactive, current effective gross does not beat or hedge the existing employment path after commute, the job is unsafe, or it conflicts with accepted work.
privacy: No person name, employer name, address, email, phone, account ID, app credential, message ID, bank data, or secret is stored.
